snippet.title: NET.CRAWL | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
NET.CRAWL is an upcoming deck-building roguelite set in a bizzarre digital world. It uses hexes instead of cards and has a strong focus on encounters with Cores (mini-bosses) each with their own unique abilities or victory condition.
#indiegame   #cyberpunk  #steam #netrunner   #indiedev #net.crawl
